summary: Full backend + frontend regression test for banbansports UI redesign (3-column dashboard). Backend: 9/9 scoped endpoints healthy. Frontend: all 15 required data-testids render, filter/banner-dot/channel/league-strip/movie-modal/box-office counter/currency-tab interactions all work; match card navigates to /match/[slug] and match detail page renders full stats correctly. No critical console errors found.

minor.issue: Invalid credentials return HTTP 200 with {ok:false, error:'Geçersiz e-posta veya parola'} instead of 401. Pre-existing API design; frontend appears to handle it via the ok flag. Not a redesign regression.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/login returns 200 for invalid credentials instead of 401 — cosmetically ok because response has ok:false, but violates HTTP semantics and complicates client-side error handling / auditing.
MatchCenter initial visibleCount=8 while flatMatches often <= 8, so 'TÜM MAÇLARI GÖR' (matches-show-more) is hidden by design — expected, but comment in code says 'başlangıçta 8' (matches PRD).

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 scoped endpoints; 1 semantic quirk on invalid-login status code)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids present, all interactions verified)
